'''Robb''' was the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] owner of the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Thirsty Bantha]] in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Before settling down, [[Gender/Legends|he]] made a living as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].
